usajmo-2018-q1.summary: For each positive integer $n$, determine the number of $n$-digit positive integers whose adjacent digits are never equal and whose last digit is prime.
usajmo-2018-q1.summaryZh: 对每个正整数 $n$，求满足下列条件的 $n$ 位正整数个数：任意相邻两位数字不相等，且末位数字为素数。

methods.title: Count a relaxed class and solve a recurrence
methods.titleZh: 先计数放宽条件的数，再解递推
steps: Let $p_n$ be the required number. Call an $n$-digit integer *good* if its last digit is one of $2,3,5,7$ and no equality occurs among the first $n-1$ adjacent pairs; we temporarily allow the last two digits to be equal.
Choose the first digit in $9$ ways, each of the next $n-2$ digits in $9$ ways, and the last prime digit in $4$ ways. Hence there are $4\cdot9^{n-1}$ good numbers.

A good number is not counted by $p_n$ exactly when its last two digits are equal. Deleting its last digit then gives, bijectively, one of the $p_{n-1}$ admissible $(n-1)$-digit numbers. Therefore $p_n=4\cdot9^{n-1}-p_{n-1}$, with $p_1=4$.
Iterating the recurrence gives $p_n=4(9^{n-1}-9^{n-2}+\cdots+(-1)^{n-1})$. Summing this finite geometric series yields $p_n=\frac{2}{5}(9^n-(-1)^n)$, which is an integer for every $n\ge1$.
stepsZh: 记所求个数为 $p_n$。若一个 $n$ 位数的末位属于 $2,3,5,7$，且前 $n-1$ 位之间的相邻数字均不相等，则称其为“良好数”；暂时允许最后两位相等。
首位有 $9$ 种选择，中间每一位都有 $9$ 种不与前一位相同的选择，末位素数有 $4$ 种选择。因此良好数共有 $4\cdot9^{n-1}$ 个。
一个良好数不计入 $p_n$，当且仅当最后两位相等。删去最后一位后，恰好得到一个符合要求的 $(n-1)$ 位数，且这是双射。因此 $p_n=4\cdot9^{n-1}-p_{n-1}$，初值为 $p_1=4$。

usajmo-2018-q2.summary: Let $a,b,c$ be positive real numbers satisfying $a+b+c=4\sqrt[3]{abc}$. Prove that $2(ab+bc+ca)+4\min(a^2,b^2,c^2)\ge a^2+b^2+c^2$.
usajmo-2018-q2.summaryZh: 设正实数 $a,b,c$ 满足 $a+b+c=4\sqrt[3]{abc}$。证明：$2(ab+bc+ca)+4\min(a^2,b^2,c^2)\ge a^2+b^2+c^2$。
usajmo-2018-q2.answer: The inequality holds; equality occurs when $(a,b,c)$ is a permutation of $((7-\sqrt{17})r,(7+\sqrt{17})r,2r)$ for some $r>0$.
usajmo-2018-q2.answerZh: 不等式成立；等号成立当且仅当 $(a,b,c)$ 是 $((7-\sqrt{17})r,(7+\sqrt{17})r,2r)$ 的某个排列，其中 $r>0$。

methods.title: One AM-GM estimate
steps: By symmetry, assume $c=\min(a,b,c)$. It is enough to prove $2(ab+bc+ca)+4c^2\ge a^2+b^2+c^2$.
Apply AM-GM to the two positive quantities $4c(a+b+c)$ and $4ab$: $4c(a+b+c)+4ab\ge2\sqrt{16abc(a+b+c)}$.
Since $abc=((a+b+c)/4)^3$, the right side equals $2\sqrt{16((a+b+c)/4)^3(a+b+c)}=(a+b+c)^2$.
Expanding $(a+b+c)^2$ and subtracting $2(ab+bc+ca)$ gives exactly $2(ab+bc+ca)+4c^2\ge a^2+b^2+c^2$.
For equality, AM-GM requires $c(a+b+c)=ab$. Together with the given condition this yields $ab=8c^2$ and $a+b=7c$, hence $a,b=\frac{7\pm\sqrt{17}}2c$. Writing $c=2r$ gives the stated equality family.
stepsZh: 由对称性，不妨设 $c=\min(a,b,c)$。只需证明 $2(ab+bc+ca)+4c^2\ge a^2+b^2+c^2$。
对正数 $4c(a+b+c)$ 与 $4ab$ 使用 AM-GM：$4c(a+b+c)+4ab\ge2\sqrt{16abc(a+b+c)}$。
展开 $(a+b+c)^2$，再从两边减去 $2(ab+bc+ca)$，恰得目标不等式。
等号要求 $c(a+b+c)=ab$。结合原条件可得 $ab=8c^2$、$a+b=7c$，从而 $a,b=\frac{7\pm\sqrt{17}}2c$。令 $c=2r$，即得到所述等号情形。

methods.title: Normalize and factor
steps: Again take $c=\min(a,b,c)$ and divide by $c^2$. Put $A=a/c$, $B=b/c$, and $D=A+B$. Then $D+1=4\sqrt[3]{AB}$, so $AB=(D+1)^3/64$.
The desired inequality becomes $2(AB+A+B)+4\ge A^2+B^2+1$, or $2D+3-D^2+4AB\ge0$.
Substitution gives $2D+3-D^2+(D+1)^3/16=(D+1)(D-7)^2/16\ge0$.
stepsZh: 仍设 $c$ 为三者最小值，并除以 $c^2$。令 $A=a/c,B=b/c,D=A+B$。由条件 $D+1=4\sqrt[3]{AB}$，故 $AB=(D+1)^3/64$。

usajmo-2018-q3.summary: A cyclic quadrilateral $ABCD$ lies on circle $\omega$ and $AC\perp BD$. Points $E,F$ are the reflections of $D$ across $BA,BC$, respectively, and $P=BD\cap EF$. The circumcircles of $EPD$ and $FPD$ meet $\omega$ again at $Q$ and $R$. Prove that $EQ=FR$.
usajmo-2018-q3.summaryZh: 圆 $\omega$ 上有内接四边形 $ABCD$，且 $AC\perp BD$。点 $E,F$ 分别是 $D$ 关于直线 $BA,BC$ 的对称点，$P=BD\cap EF$。三角形 $EPD$、$FPD$ 的外接圆分别与 $\omega$ 再交于 $Q,R$。证明 $EQ=FR$。

methods.title: Simson line, homothety, and two cyclic trapezoids
methods.titleZh: Simson 线、位似与两个圆内接梯形
steps: Let $X,Y$ be the perpendicular feet from $D$ to $BA,BC$, and let $Z=BD\cap AC$. Since $D$ is on the circumcircle of $ABC$, Simson's theorem makes $X,Y,Z$ collinear.

The homothety centered at $D$ with ratio $2$ sends $X$ to $E$ and $Y$ to $F$. It sends $Z$ to a point $P'$ lying on both $BD$ and $EF$, so $P'=P$. Because $Z$ lies on $AC$ and $BD\perp AC$, $P$ is the orthocenter of triangle $ABC$.

Reflect the orthocenter $P$ across $AB$ to $Q'$. Since $CP\perp AB$, the point $Q'$ lies on line $CP$. Reflection preserves angles, so $\angle AQ'B=\angle APB=180^\circ-\angle ACB$; hence $A,B,C,Q'$ are cyclic. Thus $Q'$ is the second intersection of ray $CP$ with $\omega$, and $AB$ is the perpendicular bisector of $PQ'$. By the definition of $E$, it is also the perpendicular bisector of $DE$.

Consequently, $PQ'\parallel DE$ and the legs $PD,Q'E$ are equal; hence $PQ'ED$ is an isosceles trapezoid and is cyclic. Therefore $Q'$ lies on the circumcircle of $EPD$. By its definition $Q'\in\omega$ and $Q'\ne D$, so $Q'=Q$. The same argument with ray $AP$ gives that $R$ is its second intersection with $\omega$.
The isosceles trapezoid $PQED$ gives $EQ=PD$. Symmetrically, the isosceles trapezoid $PRFD$ gives $FR=PD$. Hence $EQ=FR$.
stepsZh: 从 $D$ 分别向 $BA,BC$ 作垂足 $X,Y$，令 $Z=BD\cap AC$。因为 $D$ 在三角形 $ABC$ 的外接圆上，由 Simson 定理，$X,Y,Z$ 共线。
以 $D$ 为中心、倍率为 $2$ 的位似把 $X,Y$ 分别映到 $E,F$，并把 $Z$ 映到同时位于 $BD$ 与 $EF$ 上的点 $P'$，故 $P'=P$。又 $Z\in AC$ 且 $BD\perp AC$，所以 $P$ 是三角形 $ABC$ 的垂心。

把垂心 $P$ 关于 $AB$ 对称到 $Q'$。因 $CP\perp AB$，点 $Q'$ 位于直线 $CP$ 上；对称保持角度，故 $\angle AQ'B=\angle APB=180^\circ-\angle ACB$，从而 $A,B,C,Q'$ 共圆。因此 $Q'$ 是射线 $CP$ 与 $\omega$ 的另一个交点，且 $AB$ 是 $PQ'$ 的垂直平分线；由 $E$ 的定义，$AB$ 也是 $DE$ 的垂直平分线。
于是 $PQ'\parallel DE$ 且两腰 $PD=Q'E$，故 $PQ'ED$ 为等腰梯形，从而四点共圆。因此 $Q'$ 在圆 $(EPD)$ 上；又 $Q'\in\omega$ 且 $Q'\ne D$，所以 $Q'=Q$。同理，$R$ 是射线 $AP$ 与 $\omega$ 的另一个交点。
等腰梯形 $PQED$ 给出 $EQ=PD$；对称地，等腰梯形 $PRFD$ 给出 $FR=PD$。因此 $EQ=FR$。

usajmo-2018-q4.summary: Find all real $x$ for which there exists a triangle $ABC$ with circumradius $2$ and $\angle ABC\ge90^\circ$ such that $x^4+ax^3+bx^2+cx+1=0$, where $a=BC$, $b=CA$, and $c=AB$.
usajmo-2018-q4.summaryZh: 求所有实数 $x$，使得存在一个外接圆半径为 $2$ 且 $\angle ABC\ge90^\circ$ 的三角形 $ABC$，满足 $x^4+ax^3+bx^2+cx+1=0$，其中 $a=BC,b=CA,c=AB$。

methods.title: Complete two squares and force equality
methods.titleZh: 配成两个平方并锁定等号
steps: Because all side lengths and the constant term are positive, any root must satisfy $x<0$, in particular $x\ne0$.
Rewrite the left side as $(x^2+ax/2)^2+\left(b-(a^2+c^2)/4\right)x^2+(cx/2+1)^2$.
Since $\angle B\ge90^\circ$, the cosine law gives $b^2\ge a^2+c^2$. Also $b=2R\sin B=4\sin B\le4$, so $b^2\le4b$. Therefore $b-(a^2+c^2)/4\ge0$, and all three displayed terms are nonnegative.
Their sum can vanish only if $x=-a/2=-2/c$ and $b=(a^2+c^2)/4$. Both inequalities in $a^2+c^2\le b^2\le4b$ must then be equalities: $b=4$, $a^2+c^2=16$, and $ac=4$.
Thus $(a+c)^2=24$ and $(a-c)^2=8$, so $\{a,c\}=\{\sqrt6+\sqrt2,\sqrt6-\sqrt2\}$. Hence the two possible values of $x=-a/2$ are those stated.
Conversely, each ordering of these two values for $a,c$, together with $b=4$, forms a right triangle of circumradius $2$ and makes every nonnegative term above zero. Thus both values really occur.
stepsZh: 因为各边长和常数项均为正，方程的实根必有 $x<0$，特别地 $x\ne0$。
因 $\angle B\ge90^\circ$，余弦定理给出 $b^2\ge a^2+c^2$。又由正弦定理 $b=2R\sin B=4\sin B\le4$，所以 $b^2\le4b$。故中间项的系数非负，三项均非负。
和为零时必须有 $x=-a/2=-2/c$ 且 $b=(a^2+c^2)/4$。这又迫使 $a^2+c^2\le b^2\le4b$ 两处均取等号，因此 $b=4,a^2+c^2=16,ac=4$。
于是 $(a+c)^2=24,(a-c)^2=8$，故 $\{a,c\}=\{\sqrt6+\sqrt2,\sqrt6-\sqrt2\}$，而 $x=-a/2$ 给出题述两个值。
反过来，取这两个数作为 $a,c$（次序任意），并取 $b=4$，可组成外接圆半径为 $2$ 的直角三角形，且上述三个非负项都为零。因此两个值均能实现。

usajmo-2018-q5.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $a_1,\ldots,a_p$ be integers. Prove that some integer $k$ makes $a_1+k,a_2+2k,\ldots,a_p+pk$ attain at least $p/2$ distinct residues modulo $p$.
usajmo-2018-q5.summaryZh: 设 $p$ 为素数，$a_1,\ldots,a_p$ 为整数。证明：存在整数 $k$，使 $a_1+k,a_2+2k,\ldots,a_p+pk$ 模 $p$ 至少得到 $p/2$ 个不同余数。
usajmo-2018-q5.answer: Such a $k$ always exists; in fact one can guarantee at least $(p+1)/2$ distinct residues when $p$ is odd.
usajmo-2018-q5.answerZh: 这样的 $k$ 总存在；当 $p$ 为奇素数时，实际上可保证至少有 $(p+1)/2$ 个不同余数。

methods.title: Average the collisions over all slopes
methods.titleZh: 对所有斜率平均计算碰撞数
steps: The case $p=2$ is immediate, so let $p=2q+1$. For each residue $k\in\{0,1,\ldots,p-1\}$, consider the row $a_1+k,a_2+2k,\ldots,a_p+pk$ modulo $p$.
Fix two columns $i\ne j$. Their entries coincide precisely when $(i-j)k\equiv a_j-a_i\pmod p$. Since $p$ is prime and $i-j$ is nonzero modulo $p$, exactly one residue $k$ solves this equation.
Across all $p$ rows, therefore, the total number of colliding unordered column-pairs is $\binom p2=pq$. Some row has at most $q$ colliding pairs.

Read the entries of that row from left to right. Each repeated entry creates at least one colliding pair with an earlier entry. Hence at most $q$ of the $p$ entries can be repetitions, leaving at least $p-q=q+1=(p+1)/2>p/2$ distinct residues. Choose an integer representative of this row's $k$.
stepsZh: $p=2$ 时结论显然。以下设 $p=2q+1$。对每个余数 $k\in\{0,1,\ldots,p-1\}$，考察模 $p$ 的一行数 $a_1+k,a_2+2k,\ldots,a_p+pk$。
固定两列 $i\ne j$。两项相等当且仅当 $(i-j)k\equiv a_j-a_i\pmod p$。因 $p$ 为素数且 $i-j$ 模 $p$ 非零，该同余方程恰有一个 $k$。
因此在全部 $p$ 行中，同余的无序列对总数为 $\binom p2=pq$。由平均值原理，至少有一行的碰撞对不超过 $q$ 对。
从左到右读取该行。每出现一个重复余数，它至少与前面一项形成一对碰撞。因此重复项最多有 $q$ 个，不同余数至少有 $p-q=q+1=(p+1)/2>p/2$ 个。取该行 $k$ 的任意整数代表即可。

usajmo-2018-q6.summary: Cards labeled $1,2,\ldots,n$ are arranged in a row. A pair $(a,b)$ is swapped if $a>b$ and card $a$ lies left of card $b$. In order $1,2,\ldots,n$, Karl removes each card and reinserts it in the opposite position: if it had $i$ cards to its left, it is reinserted with $i$ cards to its right. Prove that the final and initial arrangements have the same number of swapped pairs.
usajmo-2018-q6.summaryZh: 标号 $1,2,\ldots,n$ 的卡片排成一列。若 $a>b$ 且卡片 $a$ 位于卡片 $b$ 左侧，则称数对 $(a,b)$ 为一个逆序对。Karl 按 $1,2,\ldots,n$ 的顺序依次取出每张卡片并放到相反位置：若取出前其左侧有 $i$ 张卡片，则重新插入后令其右侧有 $i$ 张卡片。证明最终排列与初始排列的逆序对数相同。
usajmo-2018-q6.answer: The number of swapped pairs (inversions) is invariant under the complete procedure.
usajmo-2018-q6.answerZh: 整个操作完成后，逆序对总数保持不变。

methods.title: Raise each moved label by $n$
methods.titleZh: 把每张已移动卡片的标号增加 $n$
steps: Modify the procedure as follows: just before reinserting card $i$, change its label from $i$ to $n+i$. Positions are otherwise exactly those in the original procedure.

Suppose card $i$ has $r$ cards to its left before its move, so it is reinserted with $r$ cards to its right. At this time cards $1,\ldots,i-1$ have already become labels above $n$, while the unmoved cards $i+1,\ldots,n$ retain labels below $n$.

Before the move, every other current label exceeds $i$: an already moved card has label $n+j$, and an unmoved one has label greater than $i$. Hence card $i$ belongs to exactly the $r$ inversions formed with the cards to its left. After becoming $n+i$, it exceeds every other current label and, with $r$ cards to its right, again belongs to exactly $r$ inversions.
The relative order and labels of every other pair are unchanged by this move, so each modified step preserves the total inversion count.

At the end the labels are $n+1,\ldots,2n$, in exactly the same positional order as the original procedure's final labels $1,\ldots,n$. Subtracting $n$ from every label preserves all comparisons. Hence the original final arrangement has the same inversion count as the initial one.
stepsZh: 考虑一个改写后的过程：在重新插入卡片 $i$ 之前，先把其标号由 $i$ 改为 $n+i$；插入位置与原过程完全相同。
设移动前卡片 $i$ 左侧有 $r$ 张卡片，因此插回后右侧有 $r$ 张。此时卡片 $1,\ldots,i-1$ 已经变成大于 $n$ 的标号，而尚未移动的卡片 $i+1,\ldots,n$ 仍保持不超过 $n$ 的标号。
移动前，其余每张卡片的当前标号都大于 $i$：已移动卡片的标号为 $n+j$，未移动卡片的标号则大于 $i$。因此卡片 $i$ 恰与其左侧的 $r$ 张卡片构成 $r$ 个逆序对。改标为 $n+i$ 后，它比其余所有当前标号都大；其右侧恰有 $r$ 张卡片，因此仍恰参与 $r$ 个逆序对。
该步没有改变其余任意两张卡片的相对次序与标号关系，所以改写后过程的每一步都保持逆序对总数。
最终标号为 $n+1,\ldots,2n$，其位置次序与原过程最终的 $1,\ldots,n$ 完全一致。所有标号同时减去 $n$ 不改变大小比较，故原过程最终排列与初始排列的逆序对数相同。
